notes_for_editor: The 1944 build line comes from the Forest Lookouts listing, which cites the 10th Biennial Report (1944); that report was not read directly. The tnlandforms index gives coordinates and county only. Search results for Harrisville returned Buck Mountain, a different Montgomery County tower in the Uwharrie National Forest; the story names it once, as a separate entry, and gives none of its details. The 'should not be confused' wording was removed because no source supports it. A Montgomery County history PDF had no Harrisville tower mention. The NHLR register has no Harrisville entry: the full North Carolina list (31 names) was read on the page and none is Harrisville. The brief's status and access stay unknown; the story says no source read describes the site today. Body text is about 131 words, within the guide's range.
